entry.title: Updated: dsh-vision-mix
entry.summary: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history. Exact install spec: dsh-vision-mix. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
